title: Tiny, cute robot vacuum
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='body' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c8d8f0'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#9ab0d0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7a90b0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='bumper' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb060'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e08030'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='screenGrad' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#4ae0ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#1090c0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='34' ry='6' fill='#2a3550' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- body: round disc -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='32' ry='22' fill='url(#body)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='32' ry='22' fill='none' stroke='#d8e8ff' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- top highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='24' ry='12' fill='#dce8f8' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- front bumper -->
  <path d='M20 62 A32 22 0 0 0 80 62' fill='none' stroke='url(#bumper)' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- face screen -->
  <rect x='36' y='52' width='28' height='16' rx='8' fill='url(#screenGrad)'/>
  <rect x='38' y='54' width='24' height='12' rx='6' fill='#0a1a2a'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='59' r='3' fill='#4ae0ff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='59' r='3' fill='#4ae0ff'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='58' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='58' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- happy smile -->
  <path d='M45 63 Q50 67 55 63' fill='none' stroke='#4ae0ff' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- side sensors -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='65' r='3' fill='#7a90b0'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='65' r='1.5' fill='#c8d8f0'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='65' r='3' fill='#7a90b0'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='65' r='1.5' fill='#c8d8f0'/>

  <!-- top sensor bump -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#b0c4e0'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='5' ry='2.5' fill='#dce8f8'/>

  <!-- little antenna -->
  <line x1='50' y1='44' x2='50' y2='38' stroke='#b0c4e0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='3' fill='#ffb060'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='1.5' fill='#ffe0a0'/>

  <!-- wheels underneath (peeking) -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='80' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#607090'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='80' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#607090'/>

  <!-- bottom edge detail -->
  <path d='M28 74 Q50 80 72 74' fill='none' stroke='#8098b8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- cute cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='65' r='2' fill='#ff9a9a' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='65' r='2' fill='#ff9a9a' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
